title: Strings
intro: Learn the basic ideas of Strings in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: What is a string?
items.text: A string (str) is text stored as a sequence of characters. Strings can use single, double or triple quotes.

items.heading: Indexing
items.text: String characters can be accessed by position. Python uses zero-based indexing, so the first character is at index 0.

items.heading: Slicing
items.text: A slice selects part of a string using start and stop positions.

items.heading: upper()
items.text: upper() returns a new string with letters converted to uppercase.

items.heading: lower()
items.text: lower() returns a new string with letters converted to lowercase.

items.heading: strip()
items.text: strip() removes surrounding whitespace from a string.

items.heading: len()
items.text: len() returns the number of characters in a string.

items.heading: in operator
items.text: in checks whether a substring or character exists inside a string.

items.heading: Joining strings
items.text: The + operator can join strings together.

items.heading: Strings are immutable
items.text: String methods return new strings rather than changing the original string in place.

items.heading: String methods
items.text: Methods such as replace(), split(), find() and startswith() help process text.
